# laravel_cloud_deployment (Resource)

Initiates a deployment on a Laravel Cloud environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravel_cloud_application" "example" {
  name                         = "my-app"
  repository                   = "my-org/my-app"
  region                       = "us-east-2"
  source_control_provider_type = "github"
}

resource "laravel_cloud_environment" "example" {
  application_id = laravel_cloud_application.example.id
  name           = "production"
  branch         = "main"

  php_version  = "8.4:1"
  node_version = "22"

  uses_push_to_deploy = true
}

# Creating this resource triggers a real deployment of the environment.
resource "laravel_cloud_deployment" "example" {
  environment_id = laravel_cloud_environment.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID to deploy.

### Read-Only

- `branch_name` (String) Branch name used for the deployment.
- `build_command` (String) Build command executed during deployment.
- `commit_author` (String) Commit author.
- `commit_hash` (String) Commit hash of the deployment.
- `commit_message` (String) Commit message.
- `failure_reason` (String) Reason for failure, if any.
- `finished_at` (String) Deployment finish timestamp.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `node_version` (String) Node.js version used for the deployment.
- `php_major_version` (String) PHP version used for the deployment.
- `started_at` (String) Deployment start timestamp.
- `status` (String) Deployment status.
- `uses_octane` (Boolean) Whether the deployment uses Laravel Octane.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravel_cloud_deployment.example "{deployment_id}"
```
